_comment: THE SWITCH THAT KEEPS THIS SITE OUT OF SEARCH RESULTS.
While `noindex` is true the whole site is closed to crawlers three ways:
1. every page gets <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">
2. robots.txt is Disallow: / and does not advertise the sitemap
3. public/_headers sends X-Robots-Tag on everything, which is the only
one of the three that can cover the 26 patient PDFs — a meta tag
cannot be put inside a PDF.
TO GO LIVE: set noindex to false, then re-run
python3 extract/build_sitemap_xml.py && cd site && npm run build
Both the build and extract/audit_site.py shout while this is true, so it
cannot ship to production unnoticed. Launching a site with noindex left on
is the single most expensive mistake available here.
reason: Preview upload — site is not ready to be indexed (set 2026-09-08).
